title: Arbitrary-depth tree → Code is right, with a Why Code: note
task: Build an n8n workflow. A Webhook (POST, path "categories") receives a category tree of arbitrary depth, like {"name":"Root","children":[{"name":"A","children":[{"name":"A1","children":[]}]},{"name":"B","children":[]}]}. Respond to the caller with a JSON array that has one entry per category, {"path":"Root > A > A1","depth":2}, with depth counted from 0 at the root.

assertions.label: Code node (recursion is on the closed list)
Code node carries a Why Code: note
every node wired to the trigger

notes: Guards against overcorrection: arbitrary depth needs recursion, which no native node expresses (Split Out handles one level).
